case_selection_rationale: fixed before runs: LAB50 tight, APP30 tight, APP50 tight; no cost-result selection
time_scope: exact uploaded S10: search budget 600 with 45-second reserve; LSS and realP report outside search clock
final_variant: original_output_variants[0], unchanged original LSS cost queue
first_found_time_definition: first raw-certificate acceptance of the actual final LSS output selection, not LSS admission time
best_hit_time_definition: conditional mean of that first-found time among runs matching the version-case 30-run best
primary_tests: three paired contrasts x three cases=9 two-sided mean sign-flip tests, Holm correction; n<30 unavailable
watchdog_scope: entire binary including unchanged post-search reports; larger report allowance for 30-50 groups and first-repetition top10 realP reports, not a search-budget extension
dispatch_order: rep blocks, case19/35/39, rotate arm order by rep+case index; never propagate solutions
validation_environment: same existing server Gurobi11.0.3 native library for all three arms; not pooled with historical Gurobi13 scores
